name: Uchi no Pet Jijou Vol. 2
original_name: ウチのペット事情 Vol.2
source:
In the spring, I met the half-beast, half-angel, Mint, who was banished from the heavens and left to fend for herself. We then became a couple and started to live together. Life with this bundle of cheerful energy was a joy and when Lily, a half-human, half-demon girl from the otherworld and Cacao, another half-beast, half-angel arrives, our chaotic but exciting days continue.

The seasons changed and soon summer arrived. I then meet Kuro, a mysterious girl with animal-like ears and tail yet no halo or wings.

Kuro was rather wary of others but seemed to have some sort of goal she wished to accomplish.

Mint wants to help her and drags everyone along to do so when a sinister presence makes themselves known and looks to interfere with Kuro’s goals…?!

Alongside angels, demons and a girl who is neither, all crossing paths. Mint’s chaotic summer vacation fills with twists and turns!

Follow Mint, a popular girl from the doujin circle “Animal Herb,” as her story continues in this heartwarmingly comedic game series!

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/sekai-project-announces-2-new-visual-novels-and-a-nekopara-artbook-at-anime-central-2026/]NookGaming[/url]]
translation:
春天里，我遇见了半兽半天使的薄荷，她被天界放逐，只能自生自灭。然后我们成为情侣并开始同居。拥有这股欢快能量的生活是一种快乐，当来自异界的半人半妖的女孩莉莉和另一位半兽半天使的可可到来时，我们混乱但令人兴奋的日子仍在继续。

季节更替，很快夏天就到了。然后我遇到了库洛，一个神秘的女孩，她有动物般的耳朵和尾巴，但没有光环或翅膀。

黑对别人相当警惕，但她似乎有某种想要实现的目标。

薄荷想要帮助她，并拖着大家一起去帮助她，但当一个邪恶的存在出现并试图干扰库洛的目标时……？！

与天使、恶魔和一个两者都不是的女孩一起，所有的人都在路上交叉。Mint混乱的暑假充满了波折！

跟随同人圈“Animal Herb”中的热门女孩Mint，在这个温馨的喜剧游戏系列中继续她的故事！

[来自[url=https://www.nookgaming.com/sekai-project-announces-2-new-visual-novels-and-a-nekopara-artbook-at-anime-central-2026/]NookGaming[/url]]
